title: CAFE: Confining Feature Distillation to Language-Routed Adapters for Compact Multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.19134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feature distillation is usually expected to add to logit distillation. We find that this expectation does not hold for two common feature losses in compact multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), and analyze why through their gradients. The gradient of a projection-based loss is orthogonal to the task gradient, while that of Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), a similarity-based loss, is weakly aligned with it. CKA lowers the word error rate (WER) on non-English languages, but at the expense of data-rich English. Three loss-level remedies (one trained, two probed) all fall short, and the CKA gradient overlaps with the subspace English uses in the shared encoder by 97.5% to 99.5% (about 81% by chance). Guided by this diagnosis, we propose CAFE (Confined-Adapter Feature distillation), which confines the CKA gradient to adapters that English bypasses, addressing the trade-off in the parameters rather than in the loss. On the Open ASR

translated_title: CAFE：将特征蒸馏限制在语言路由适配器中，以实现紧凑型多语言自动语音识别
translated_abstract: 特征蒸馏通常被认为能够补充logit蒸馏的效果。我们发现，在紧凑型多语言自动语音识别（ASR）中，这一预期对两种常见的特征损失并不成立，并通过分析它们的梯度来探究原因。基于投影的损失函数的梯度与任务梯度正交，而基于相似性的损失函数中心核对对齐（CKA）的梯度与任务梯度仅呈弱对齐。CKA降低了非英语语言上的词错误率（WER），但以牺牲数据丰富的英语为代价。三种损失层面的补救措施（一种通过训练，两种通过探测）均未能解决问题，且CKA梯度与英语在共享编码器中所使用的子空间的重叠度高达97.5%至99.5%（随机情况下约为81%）。基于这一诊断，我们提出了CAFE（受限适配器特征蒸馏），它将CKA梯度限制在英语所绕过的适配器中，从参数层面而非损失层面来解决这一权衡问题。在Open ASR...
tldr: 提出CAFE方法，通过将CKA特征蒸馏梯度限制在英语绕过的语言路由适配器中，从参数层面解决了紧凑型多语言语音识别中非英语与英语性能之间的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes CAFE, which confines CKA feature distillation gradients to language-routed adapters that English bypasses, resolving the trade-off between non-English and English performance in compact multilingual ASR at the parameter level rather than the loss level.
